findings.summary: The component renders two page-level h1 headings.
findings.consequence: Assistive-technology heading navigation exposes both the author name and the bibliography panel as top-level page headings instead of presenting the bibliography title as a subsection of the author page.
findings.evidence: The owned template begins at line 271 and renders the author name as an h1, then later renders `Bibliografisk databas` as another h1 inside `.page_content`. The SSR and visual tests currently assert `.page_content h1`, so they preserve the duplicated page-level outline rather than protecting heading semantics.
findings.recommendation: Change the inner bibliography title to h2 and preserve its visual styling with a class or CSS selector that does not depend on h1 semantics; update tests to assert the accessible heading level or text without requiring `.page_content h1`.
